description.value:
Rank 4 Ki Technique

  • Ki Cost: 90 Ki
  • Prerequisites: 1 Star in Big Bang Attack and Final Flash
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: Self (150 foot line)
  • Chargeable?: Yes
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Type: Beam

The user forms two Big Bang Attacks in his hands and put them together forming a larger blue version of the Final Flash. Targets in range must make a Dexterity Saving Throw taking 12d12 Ki Damage on a fail, half on a success.

system.requirements: 1 Star in *Big Bang Attack* and *Final Flash*
